d.seg: എങ്ങനെ കോൺടാക്ട് ചെയ്യും എൻ്റെ നമ്പർ തരാം
d.tr: How to contact? I will give my number.
d.ctx: The user asks how to contact the expert and offers to provide their phone number. The expert responds by asking if it is an Andhra Pradesh number.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the contact outside the app by offering their phone number.

d.seg: സെവൻ ത്രീ സീറോ മ് സിക്സ് സീറോ സിക്സ് സീറോ സെവൻ ഫോർ സെവൻ ഫോർ നയൻ ഡബിൾ ടു
d.ctx: The user provides their phone number in pieces. The expert questions if it is an Andhra Pradesh number.
d.j: The user is providing their phone number to move the contact outside the app.

d.seg: എനിക്ക് വാട്സാപ്പിൽ ഹായ് ഞാൻ അനുരോധം നീയേ വാട്സാപ്പിൽ
d.tr: Hi me on WhatsApp, I am Anusha, you on WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The user asks the expert to message them on WhatsApp. The expert responds by asking if the user is the one calling.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the contact to WhatsApp, an external app.

d.tr: There is no message on my WhatsApp.
d.ctx: The user mentions checking their WhatsApp for a message from the expert.
d.j: The user is confirming the move to an external app (WhatsApp) by checking for messages there.
